# INPUTS

| property     | type                                  | required | default | description              |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------ |
| projectId    | string                                | true     | -       | Project id               |
| pipelineData | Partial<PipelineModels.ModelPipeline> | true     | -       | Project pipeline information |

```typescript
interface ModelPipeline {
  /** Pipeline id, automatically generated by the server */
  id: string;

  /** Pipeline name */
  alias_name: string;

  /** Content of the yaml file */
  workflow_type: "yaml_path" | "yaml_string" | "yaml_url" | "yaml_template";

  /** Template version */
  template_version: "produce" | "test";

  /** Location where the workflow yaml is stored */
  yaml_path: string;

  /** workflow definition string */
  yaml_string: string;

  /** workflow definition url */
  yaml_url: string;

  /** timeout Minute */
  step_timeout: number;

  /** Pipeline global variables */
  variables: {
    /** name */
    name?: string;

    /** value */
    value?: string;
  }[];

  /** Notification */
  notify: {
    /** Notification time points: when the build starts / when the build succeeds / when the build fails */
    mode?: ("OnStart" | "OnSucceed" | "OnFail")[];

    /** Notification method */
    methods?: string[];

    /** List of users to notify */
    users?: string[];

    /** List of user groups to notify */
    user_groups?: string[];
  };

  /** Creator, automatically generated by the server */
  creator: string;

  /** Creation time, automatically generated by the server */
  ctime: string;

  /** Modification time, automatically generated by the server */
  mtime: string;
}
```
